"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Russia should also display self-restraint in its shipments of sensitive nuclear and military technology to Iran.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Russia must also choose lasting stability over transitory profit and support the effort against proliferation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
